page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-60-lssd is a general-purpose server powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 30 physical cores and 60 vCPUs with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The system is configured with 240 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of four NVMe SSDs totaling 1608 GB of local capacity. The CPU includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores placing in the top 25%. Cached memory read-only bandwidth is highly efficient at 4247.26 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read and write speeds fall into the average tier. Single-core performance is moderate, with Geekbench single-core and text processing scores landing in the middle 50%. The server demonstrates strong capabilities in specialized tasks, including software compilation, ray tracing, image processing, and Redis SET operations, which achieved 78.94 million operations per second.

From a resource density perspective, the server offers a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio alongside high-speed local NVMe storage, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring fast local scratch space without the premium of memory-optimized instances. However, the tradeoff lies in its average single-threaded performance and uncached memory bandwidth compared to its strong multi-threaded execution. This hardware profile is suited for database operations, multi-threaded software compilation, containerized microservices, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
